content: The treatment approach for foot ulcers, as recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), varies based on the assessed risk level of the patient. For individuals classified as low risk, the management primarily involves providing patient education and encouraging self-care practices to prevent complications. For those identified as moderate to high risk, it is advised to refer the patient to foot care specialists. These specialists will conduct regular monitoring and implement necessary interventions to address the condition and mitigate further risks.
